title: [Master]-Project consumption: partial invoicing of non-inventory items posts negative adjustment value entry to wrong Item Ledger Entry
summary: Fixed posting of negative adjustment value entries for partially invoiced non-inventory items in project consumption, which were incorrectly linked to the wrong item ledger entry.
key_points: Partial invoicing of non-inventory items consumed on a project no longer posts the negative adjustment value entry to the wrong item ledger entry
One-line fix in codeunit 90 Purch.-Post, repeated in the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, RU and W1 layers
New tests added to Job Consumption Purchase in the W1 and RU layers
